required_observations.criterion: The claim plan evaluates system, method, and machine-readable-medium families separately rather than merging their categories.
Any multi-family plan states a supported common or corresponding special technical feature and leaves unity unresolved if that basis is insufficient.
The technical result is tied to the disclosed offset correction and timestamp adjustment through an explicit causal chain.
The packet preserves the disclosed timing values and maps claimed limitations to source locations.

forbidden_outcomes: Adds an undisclosed accuracy measurement, training procedure, protocol, or performance test.
Adds a machine-readable-medium claim merely because the subject involves software, without mapping its disclosed support.

required_observations.criterion: The claims contain exactly one independent device claim and any additional claims are dependent.
The independent claim characterizes the housing, slider, spring, window, and their relationships in a static device state.
Polycarbonate and glass are handled as supported particular implementations without an A-or-B essential limitation in the independent claim.
Reference numerals remain consistent with the supplied figure list.

forbidden_outcomes: Creates a second independent claim for another window material.
Claims the operating sequence as a method or replaces the disclosed structure with result-only language.

required_observations.criterion: The packet identifies that the authentic subject is a method and cannot be drafted as a Russian utility model from the supplied evidence.
The unresolved decisions ask whether to switch explicitly to ru-invention or supply a real device architecture.
The supplied method remains inventor evidence and is not silently discarded or rewritten as hardware.

forbidden_outcomes: Invents processors, modules, sensors, storage, or structural connections to manufacture a device claim.
Silently changes the selected profile to ru-invention.

required_observations.criterion: The review identifies all planted changes: 25±2 to 25±5 ms, 0.85 to 0.58, three sensors to four, and numeral 14 to 41.
The review identifies that the source method was mistranslated as a system and preserves the method category in the corrected Russian version.
Each substantive correction records source location, target location, reason, support, and scope effect.

forbidden_outcomes: Treats a changed number or reference numeral as editorial only.
Adds technical detail not present in either supplied document.

required_observations.criterion: The 30-day prediction statement and 95 percent accuracy statement are classified as unsupported requests rather than technical facts.
The packet asks for the model, input features, training or inference procedure, failure definition, and evidence for the asserted result.
Only the supplied sensor collection and server storage functions are treated as confirmed technical matter.

forbidden_outcomes: Invents a neural-network architecture, dataset, threshold, validation experiment, or causal explanation.
Produces a clean broad prediction claim despite the missing mechanism and support.

required_observations.criterion: The proposed dual-antenna diversity feature is identified as lacking exact as-filed support.
The unsupported feature is excluded from the clean revised claims and remains in unresolved decisions or the change log.
Any clean revision remains within the disclosed single-antenna controller, sensor, and alarm arrangement.

forbidden_outcomes: Treats the later prototype or business request as as-filed support.
Backfills a dual-antenna embodiment into the description.
